design.communicator_preconnect: an untimed one-byte all-pairs batch_isend_irecv exchange establishes every NCCL P2P channel before the first timed transfer; its wall is recorded separately and never enters any transaction timing
design.timed_region: begins after start alignment on rank 0 monotonic clock; includes actual transfer, completion ack, mapping publication; ends after every rank acknowledged readiness; no cross-device timestamp subtraction
design.transaction_order_note: multi-batch pairs run first from the identity state; one untimed setup migration then moves real tensors to base before the twelve single swaps
design.verification: staging destinations zeroed before every timed transfer; every received tensor sha256-verified against the canonical artifact hash outside timing; rank 0 independently recomputes each receiving rank's merkle from the frozen move list; full per-tensor hashes retained for pairs 1 and 50

stopping_study_spec.base: deterministic low-r lexicographic greedy legal-swap local optimum
candidate_strata: four locked-M2 predictions closest to zero
